title: Cianidanol from Sea Buckthorn Exert Anti-Inflammatory Effects by the Inhibiting JAK2/STAT3 Signaling Pathway via an Integrative Pharmacology Strategy.
authors: Liu, Chuan; Yi, Xiangrui; Li, Yafan; Xu, Huijuan; Wang, Peng; Yang, Wenyu; Li, Ling; Tu, Ya
journal: Plant foods for human nutrition (Dordrecht, Netherlands)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究沙棘活性成分的抗炎机制，涉及JAK2/STAT3信号通路及分子对接/动力学，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Sea buckthorn is a model of medicine and food homology, but the chemical composition and mechanism of anti-inflammatory effects are limited. In this study, the key components and mechanisms of the anti-inflammatory effects of sea buckthorn were identified based on UPLC-Q-TOF-MS, network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics and RAW264.7 cells. The predicted key anti-inflammatory compounds in sea buckthorns were cianidanol, kaempferol, pelargonidin, and ent-epicatechin, and the key targets were EGFR, TNF, STAT3, and IL-10. The anti-inflammatory effects of sea buckthorn may be achieved via the synergistic regulation of multiple biological pathways. Furthermore, cianidanol significantly reduced the secretion of NO, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta and the expression of phosphorylated JAK2 and STAT3 in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, as determined by ELISA and western blotting. Cianidanol from sea buckthorns exerts anti-inflammatory effects by reducing the expression of inflammatory mediators and pro-inflammatory cytokines, and inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. Thus, sea buckthorn can be developed into a promising functional food with anti-inflammatory properties.
abstract_zh: 沙棘是药食同源的典范，但其化学成分及抗炎作用机制的研究尚有限。本研究基于UPLC-Q-TOF-MS、网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学及RAW264.7细胞，鉴定了沙棘抗炎作用的关键成分及机制。预测的沙棘关键抗炎化合物为儿茶素、山柰酚、天竺葵素及表儿茶素，关键靶点为EGFR、TNF、STAT3和IL-10。沙棘的抗炎作用可能通过多条生物通路的协同调控实现。此外，经ELISA和蛋白质印迹法测定，儿茶素显著降低了LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中NO、IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β的分泌，以及磷酸化JAK2和STAT3的表达。沙棘中的儿茶素通过降低炎症介质和促炎细胞因子的表达，并抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路，发挥抗炎作用。因此，沙棘可开发为具有抗炎特性的有前景的功能性食品。
